## Description and Rationale

I am an independent researcher and developer focused on building data-driven solutions. My motivation for joining DC2026 is to tackle the complex variables behind airport traffic and accurate taxi-out time prediction. I strongly believe in the power of open-source collaboration for aviation intelligence, and I want to contribute my technical expertise to this valuable ecosystem.
